title: 任务与存档系统故障导致进度受阻
description: 任务中断、存档损坏、数据异常等问题导致玩家无法正常推进游戏或保存进度。
evidence: Even save game management is broken in ways that should never have been released to the public
Most quests simply break along the way and cannot be completed
i end up losing all of my progress

evidence_items.quote: Loaded up that save after a day and hit with mortgage for my ship as it was 00:00 on 9/1. What's this? Also a mortgage for 00:00 8/1? That's before the start date on the damn game.
evidence_items.description: 存档加载后出现日期错误的抵押贷款，包括游戏开始日期之前的贷款
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一天后加载那个存档，结果在9月1日00:00收到了我飞船的抵押贷款。这是什么？还有一笔8月1日00:00的抵押贷款？那是在这该死的游戏的开始日期之前。

evidence_items.quote: Even save game management is broken in ways that should never have been released to the public
evidence_items.description: 存档管理功能损坏，不应在公开发布版本中出现。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 就连存档管理都以绝不该向公众发布的方式坏掉了

evidence_items.quote: Most quests simply break along the way and cannot be completed
evidence_items.description: 大多数任务在过程中会中断，无法完成。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大多数任务就是会在途中坏掉，无法完成

evidence_items.quote: I couldn't do a single mission or quest in the time i played couldn't even start one
evidence_items.description: 游玩期间无法完成或开始任何一个任务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 在我玩的那段时间里，我一个任务或委托都做不了，甚至连一个都没法开始

evidence_items.quote: quest system doesn't work that well
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务系统运行得不太好

evidence_items.quote: The missions are bugged and randomly disappear.
I don't like having to restart with every update
evidence_items.description: 每次更新都要重新开始
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我不喜欢每次更新都得重新开始

evidence_items.quote: Launched the save, owed a million $ (in past due payments somehow) in debt on a ship worth 1.5mil preventing me from undocking
evidence_items.description: 读档后莫名出现巨额逾期债务
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载存档后，欠了一百万美元（不知怎么地算作逾期付款）的债务，压在一艘价值150万的飞船上，让我无法脱离对接

evidence_items.quote: i end up losing all of my progress
evidence_items.description: 游戏无法继续导致所有进度丢失
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我最终失去了所有进度

evidence_items.description: 存档损坏导致丢失18小时进度

evidence_items.quote: The missions are bugged and randomly disappear.
quest system doesn't work that well
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任务系统运行得不太好
